features.name: Configurable controls and hotkeys
features.description: Fully rebindable keyboard, mouse and gamepad controls. 146 hotkey commands covering gameplay, toggles, zoom levels, chat commands and windows. Default: Space=split, W=eject, E=macro, Q=double-split. Mouse buttons and scroll wheel are configurable. All hotkeys can be rebound or left unassigned.

features.name: Custom skins, video skins and skin tools
features.description: Apply custom image URLs (PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG) as cell skins. Video skins play MP4/WebM/OGV files with a configurable audio level. Skin checker tests URL validity. Skin rotator cycles through skins automatically. IndexedDB cache stores up to 1,000 skins and 600 audio entries with LRU eviction.

features.name: Themes and HUD customization
features.description: Visual customization via CSS variables and 8 theme presets (Legend v2, v1, Original, Crazy Style 2/1, Agar.io Light/Dark, Colour-blind Safe). ~160 theme properties: colours, fonts, sizing, menu, HUD, chat, minimap, custom background/cursor. Theme Bridge syncs with game CSS variables. HUD blur, rainbow borders, virus effects, cell contours, cell shadows, streamer preset.

features.name: Theme Workshop
features.description: Create, save, rename, copy and delete custom themes. My Themes library stores up to 30 themes with 5 saved versions each. Live preview with 15-second auto-revert. Side-by-side comparison. Gallery of shipped themes. Theme packages include theme, sounds, cursor, background and HUD layout. Validated against LM_THEME_DEFAULTS schema. HTTPS-only URLs.

features.name: Mobile touch controls
features.description: Dedicated on-screen touch buttons for split, feed and movement. PWA support with fullscreen landscape play and screen wake lock. Customizable phone button layout editor.

features.name: Gamepad support
features.description: Full controller support. The 16 buttons are bound in the Hotkeys window like keys and mouse buttons (any hotkey command; click a field and press the button). Default: A=split, B=feed, X=doubleSplit, Y=respawn, LB=multibox, RB=split16. Settings: dead zone (0.05-0.5), response curve (0.5-3), zoom sensitivity (0.2-4), trigger threshold, axis inversion, haptic vibration on split and death (Gamepad window, with a live test).

features.name: Multibox controls
features.description: Control up to 4 game connections simultaneously. Colour-coded rings per player (independent colour, size, active-only settings for P1/P2). Middle camera view, auto-respawn, switch-after-death, freeze mode, camera smoothing, multibox shadow. Bot controls: bot feed, split, macro, double/pop/16-split.

features.name: Replay tools and Replay Studio
features.description: Record server packets for faithful replays. Replay Studio: full timeline with automatic bookmarks, variable speed (0.25x-4x), pause, packet-by-packet stepping, forward/backward seeking, timeline scrubbing. Instant replay plays last 15-60 seconds. Clip export as .lm files. Match history stores last 50 lives. Personal bests tracked. Replay library in IndexedDB.

features.name: WebGL rendering and performance diagnostics
features.description: WebGL2 acceleration with Canvas2D fallback. High DPI rendering, FPS cap (0-240), menu FPS cap (25 FPS), performance mode (one-switch for weak devices). Adaptive performance monitors real frame times with 3 degradation levels: L1 decorative off, L2 jelly/video off, L3 lower resolution. Self-healing. Diagnostics window with frame time graph, percentiles, Chrome LoAF integration. Net graph overlay. Network history.

features.name: Settings profiles
features.description: Up to 30 named profiles storing gameplay settings, theme, hotkeys and phone controls. 6 built-in starter templates (FFA, teams, multibox, streaming, mobile, competitive). Auto-switching per server type, game mode or input device. Side-by-side comparison. 5 automatic backups. Import/export as JSON. Hotkeys for open/next/prev/undo.

features.name: Chat system
features.description: In-game text chat with image/video sharing, emoticons, auto-translation, universal cross-server chat, mention notifications, coloured nicks, word filter, player ID display. 50 customizable chat command slots. Voice chat (push-to-talk). Team pings (Help, Danger, Go here, Virus). Chat message and command sounds with their own volumes (Settings > Sounds).

features.name: HUD helpers
features.description: Split range circles (single/double/triple/quad), merge countdown with sound and progress rings, relative mass display, edge arrows for teammates and threats, cell mass panel, move direction arrow. Mass format modes (short/exact/12.3k/auto). Precision zoom.

features.name: HUD Editor
features.description: Drag and resize 14 HUD components (leaderboard, minimap, stats, team, time, target, chatBox, chatInput, popups, netGraph, cellPanel, bell, etc.). Up to 20 named layouts. Scale 0.3x-3x per box. Grid snapping (0/8/16/32px). Lock and hide per box. Edge-relative positioning for responsiveness.

features.name: Stats and analytics
features.description: Live stats HUD (mass, FPS, ping, PPS, jitter, server Hz, alive time, 16-cell count). Kill feed (6s, 5 lines). Death recap (last 20s, 3-6 steps, mass sparkline, killer attribution). Mass graph on Game Over card. Mass loss alerts (10-90% threshold). Analytics dashboard with heatmaps, 500 game summaries and the match history.

features.name: Notification centre
features.description: Bell icon with unread count. 8 categories: achievements, bests, party, replay, connection, settings, chat, other. Up to 200 notifications (120KB). Filterable list, mark read, clear, per-category muting. Sound mixer integration.

features.name: Scan trick and line split
features.description: Scan trick: hold its key and the cell heads far out toward the cursor at the exact angle; with the left mouse button held too it snaps to 16 directions (no settings). Line split: straight-line rapid multi-split (x8 or x16) with configurable delay, hold time, and guide lines.

features.name: Practice Arena
features.description: Offline drills against bots (no server needed). 8 exercise modes: free, split, virus, dodge, path, escape, feed, merge. Uses MultiOgar protocol. Personal bests with ghost replay of best run. Configurable: seed, start mass, bots (0-30), difficulty (1-4), viruses (0-4), map size, latency simulation (0-500ms), duration (10-600s).

features.name: Custom macros
features.description: 3 macro slots with customizable names. Up to 24 steps per macro, 48 max events, 5 seconds max total. 4 action types: split (1-8x), feed (1-8x), wait (10-2000ms), move to mouse. Dry run mode. Safety limits: 20ms between splits, 10ms between feeds.

features.name: User scripts and plugins
features.description: 5 script slots for custom JavaScript. Plugin header format: ==LMPlugin== with name, version, author, permissions (8 types). Settings API: up to 20 settings per plugin. Catalogue of example plugins. Version compatibility checking. Third-party URL confirmation prompt.

features.name: Accessibility features
features.description: Reduced motion in Settings > Expanding Land (no Expanding Land death shake, particles, entrance spin). Menu text scale (1.0-1.6x). HUD text scale (independent). Colour-blind safe theme preset (Okabe-Ito). Clean HUD preset. Focus warning toast.

features.name: Privacy and streamer mode
features.description: Streamer preset: one-click setup hiding country, chat, images, videos, dev console. Stream mode blurs nick, clan tag and skin URL. Hide skin URL, own name, country flag. Debug info redaction for screenshots.

features.name: 16-language support
features.description: Translated into Arabic, Bulgarian, German, Greek, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian (beta), Italian (beta), Japanese (beta), Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (beta), Russian, Turkish, and Traditional Chinese. Over 2,000 strings per language. Per-page translation packs for all site pages.

features.name: Player Monitor
features.description: Live dashboard showing all online players across all servers. Displays nickname, tag, name, Agar ID, server, region, game mode, level, country and last seen time. Summary cards: total online, active servers, unique countries. History page tracks player activity over time. Supports 16-language UI.

features.name: Death recap
features.description: Game Over card showing the last 20 seconds of your life as 3-6 summarised steps with a mass sparkline. Attributes the killer by name and mass from eat events. Expanding Land uses server-provided killer info for accuracy.

features.name: Kill feed
features.description: Fading list of kills and deaths displayed left of the leaderboard. Each entry stays 6 seconds, maximum 5 visible at once. Shows mass gained or lost per event.

features.name: Sound volumes
features.description: Settings > Sounds has each sound's switch, sound file and volume: chat message and command sounds (with their volumes), the virus sound (a virus is shot, or you pop or eat one), the 16 pieces sounds, a gameplay effects volume and a master volume (0-100%) that also scales the video skins (their own level is in Settings > Skins).
